title: Seated Robot in Basement
description: A humanoid robot with a boxy monitor head sits slumped on a concrete floor with legs spread wide. Its torso is silver and red with visible mechanical joints, one red eye glowing on its screen face, set inside a dimly lit industrial utility room with exposed pipes and a door in the background.
